mapper.insert: insert into mem_vector_${dim} (memory_id, user_id, agent_id, embedding) values (#{memoryId}, #{userId}, #{agentId}, cast(#{embedding} as vector)) on conflict (memory_id) do update set user_id = excluded.user_id, agent_id = excluded.agent_id, embedding = excluded.embedding
mapper.select: select v.memory_id as "memoryId", (1 - (v.embedding <=> cast(#{queryVector} as vector))) as score from mem_vector_${dim} v where v.user_id = #{userId} and v.agent_id in (0, #{agentId}) order by v.embedding <=> cast(#{queryVector} as vector) limit #{topK}
